motion_texts.string: That the following actions be taken with respect to the 6th Report of the Environmental Stewardship and Action Community Advisory Committee, from the meeting held on June 25, 2026:
a) the following actions be taken with respect to the Environmental Stewardship and Action Community Advisory Committee (ESACAC) budget request:
